situation: Freelance photographer. Shot a restaurant's new menu, invoice #2231 for $1,850 was due Sept 12. Sent a friendly reminder last week, nothing back. Contact is the owner, Marco.
reply:
Subject: Overdue: Invoice #2231

Hi Marco,
Following up on invoice #2231 ($1,850, due 12 September) for the menu shoot, now over two weeks overdue. Could you let me know when I can expect payment, or if there's an issue on your side I should know about? I've copied in your bookkeeper, Anna, in case that helps, and attached the invoice again with bank details.
Thanks,
Jess
note: Stage 2: finance copied in, a direct question, no apology for chasing.

situation: 我给一家连锁健身品牌拍了秋季宣传片，发票号FT-0712，金额26,000元，8月20日到期，一直没付。原来对接的市场部刘经理上个月离职了，现在接手的是孙经理，我们从没打过交道。
reply: 孙经理您好，我是陈悦，7月给贵司拍秋季宣传片的摄影师，之前一直和刘经理对接。发票FT-0712，金额26,000元，8月20日到期，目前我这边还没有收到。合同、发票和刘经理签字的验收单都在附件里，收款账户写在发票上。麻烦您在10月9日（周五）前告诉我预计的付款日期，我同时抄送了贵司财务部。
note: 对接人换了，先一句话说清你是谁、做了什么，把合同、发票和验收单一次附齐，让新人不用翻旧邮件就能直接走付款流程。

situation: Client promised to pay my $4,000 invoice last Friday and it didn't come. When I followed up he snapped that I'm 'hounding' him and he'll pay when he can. I'm a web developer and phase 2 is supposed to start next week.
reply: I understand it's been a stressful month. The amount and due date haven't changed: invoice #0917, $4,000, due 1 September. If cash flow is the issue, I can take $2,000 by Friday 2 October and $2,000 by 30 October, confirmed in writing. Phase 2 starts once the first payment arrives.
note: Ignore the tone, restate the facts, offer one real way to pay, and hold the work.

situation: Freelance translator. Invoice #0417 for €2,400 was due September 1. Their accounts person, Lukas, said on the 10th it was 'being processed' and then nothing. It's now four weeks late.
reply:
Subject: Overdue: Invoice #0417

Hi Lukas,
Following up on invoice #0417 for €2,400, due 1 September and now four weeks overdue. On 10 September you mentioned it was being processed. Could you confirm the date it's scheduled to be paid? If anything is holding it up, such as a PO number or updated bank details, tell me today and I'll send it straight over. If payment hasn't arrived by Friday 9 October, I'll pause work on the October brochure until it clears. Invoice attached again for convenience.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
note: 'Being processed' gets a request for a specific pay date, an offer to remove any blocker, and the next consequence with a date you will keep.

situation: Built a website for a yoga studio. Invoice #1108 for $3,200 was due Sept 15. The owner, Megan, now says she'll only pay $2,400 because the booking page went live a week late.
reply: Hi Megan, thanks for telling me where you're at. You're right that the booking page went live on September 8 instead of September 1, and I'm sorry for that week. The scope and price we agreed on July 20 didn't change, so invoice #1108 stays at $3,200. The $2,400 isn't in dispute, so could you pay that by Friday, October 2, to the bank details on the invoice? I'm free for a 15 minute call on Thursday to settle the remaining $800.
note: Dispute: own the real delay without discounting unasked, get the undisputed portion paid now, and move the rest to a call.

situation: Illustrator. Invoice #0932 for $2,750 to a small agency was due August 14. I've sent a reminder, a follow-up and a firm one with a Sept 25 deadline that passed. Contact is Jordan, nothing back.
reply: Hi Jordan, this is a final notice for invoice #0932 for $2,750, due 14 August and now 46 days overdue. If payment isn't received by Friday 9 October, I'll file a small claims case for the full amount plus the late fee set out in our agreement. I'd still rather settle this directly: a call this week, or a payment plan confirmed in writing, would be enough. Bank details are on the attached invoice. Mei
note: Final notice: one date, one consequence you will actually take, and a last easy way to settle.

situation: 我做企业培训，给一家公司上了两天课，发票号HX-0826，金额18,000元，8月31日到期。对方行政赵经理说好上周五9月25日付，到今天还没到账。他们10月下旬还约了第二期。
reply: 赵经理您好，发票HX-0826的18,000元，您之前说9月25日付款，目前我这边还没有收到。麻烦您明天9月30日（周三）下午5点前确认一下是否已经付出，我同时抄送了贵司财务部的李姐。款项到账前，第二期课程的日期我先不做确认。
note: 对方给的日期一过就发，只写发票、金额、日期和下一步后果；截止时间放在国庆长假之前，免得一拖就是一周。

situation: I run an online Spanish conversation club, $39 a month, about 300 members. I'm writing the automated email that goes out 7 days after a card payment fails. The due-date one already exists.
reply:
Hi Marta, your October payment of $39 still hasn't gone through, which usually means an expired or replaced card. You can update it in about a minute with the button below. Your membership stays active in the meantime, so you won't miss Thursday's conversation class. Any questions, just reply and you'll reach me, not a bot.
Lucía
note: Day 7 in an automated sequence: amount, one-click fix, a real reply-to, and shorter than the first. Keep the pause for the final message.

situation: Freelance copywriter. Invoice #3317 for $1,600 to a skincare brand was due Friday Sept 25. Nothing has come in yet. My contact is their marketing lead, Hannah. This is my first reminder.
reply:
Hi Hannah,
A quick note that invoice #3317 for $1,600 was due on Friday 25 September and I haven't seen it come through yet. It may just be in the queue; if so, please ignore this. I've attached the invoice again with the bank details for convenience.
Thanks,
Owen
note: Stage 1 assumes admin error: everything needed to pay, no apology for asking, and no consequence yet.

situation: Je suis graphiste freelance. Ma facture n°2026-114 de 3 600 € était due le 31 août. Le client, Julien, m'écrit qu'il a des soucis de trésorerie et propose de payer « dès que possible, par petits montants ». La phase 2 doit démarrer bientôt.
reply: Bonjour Julien, merci de me le dire franchement, c'est plus simple pour tous les deux. Je peux accepter un paiement en trois fois pour la facture n°2026-114 (3 600 €) : 1 200 € le vendredi 2 octobre, 1 200 € le lundi 2 novembre et 1 200 € le mardi 1er décembre. Pouvez-vous me confirmer cet échéancier par retour de mail d'ici jeudi 1er octobre ? Dès réception du premier versement, je lance la phase 2 comme prévu.
note: Un « dès que possible » devient un échéancier daté et écrit : on accepte le plan, pas le flou, et la suite du travail dépend du premier versement.

situation: I rent out a one-bed flat to Jordan, who's paid $1,450 on the 20th every month for two years without fail. September's rent hasn't arrived and it's now 9 days late. I don't want to sound like I'm accusing him.
reply: Hi Jordan, a quick note that September's rent of $1,450, due on the 20th, hasn't come through on my side yet. You've always been spot on, so it may just be a transfer that didn't go through. Could you check and let me know by Friday when it's on its way? If something's come up, tell me and we'll work out a plan.
note: Stage one with a long clean record: assume admin error, give the amount and due date, and leave room for a real problem.

situation: 6月份大学室友阿杰修车，我借了他5000块，他说8月底前还，到现在快10月了也没提。我们关系一直挺好，不想闹僵，但这钱得要回来。
reply: 阿杰，6月借你的那5000块，你当时说8月底还，我这边还没收到。这周能先转给我吗？一次不方便的话，分两次也行，10月15号前还清就好，你定个时间告诉我。
note: 借给朋友的钱也按催款来：金额、原定时间、一个具体的新日期，不说情绪，也不在闲聊里夹着提。

situation: 8月31日退租，房东王阿姨当时验房说没问题，说押金6000块一周内退。到现在快一个月了还没退，上周发微信问过一次，她只回了句“最近忙”。
reply: 王阿姨您好，8月31日退租时您验过房，说押金6000元一周内退，到今天快一个月了，我这边还没收到。麻烦您10月9日前转到我之前交房租的那张招商银行卡上。如果转之前需要我这边提供什么，您直接告诉我。
note: 对方说“忙”，就给一个具体日期；日期过了还没退，下一条先对照租房合同里的押金条款，写明下一步打算怎么做。

situation: Freelance UX writer in Toronto. A client in Munich paid invoice #0822 for €3,000 (due 15 September), but only €2,940 arrived, so it looks like transfer fees were taken off. Our contract says the client covers transfer charges. My contact is Katrin.
reply:
Hi Katrin,
Thanks for settling invoice #0822, the payment arrived on 28 September. The amount received was €2,940 rather than €3,000, so it looks like transfer fees were deducted along the way. Clause 6 of our agreement has transfer charges covered by the sender, so could you send the remaining €60 by Friday 9 October? The bank details are on the invoice as before.
Thanks,
Priya
note: Short payment: thank them for what arrived, name the exact gap, point to the contract, and still put a date on a small amount.
